title: policy.json: kb
description: The knowledge base (design part 8): the size budgets `hitld kb check` holds notes and the index to, and when a note with no sources counts as stale.

index_tokens_max.description: The index's budget in tokens (estimated as characters / 4). Above it, `hitld kb index` splits the index by area: a top-level index of areas and kb/areas/<area>/index.md for each.

note_tokens_max.description: A note's budget in tokens (estimated as characters / 4), front matter included. `hitld kb check` refuses a note above it.

max_age_unsourced.description: Days after its `checked` date that a note with no `sources` counts as stale. 0 is off.
